searchText: I agree that this is rather ambiguously specified and should be clarified in the specifications. But I agree with interpretation of <@403636673914863626>. Empty content should not be send as this will typically be seen as erroneous data being send by the peer (at least that how it works for ~~fluffy~~ nimbus).
